Image Color Picker

Click any pixel of an uploaded image to get its color.

–
HEX
–
RGB
–
HSL

📖 How to use

  1. Upload an image (PNG or JPG).
  2. Move the mouse over it for a live HEX/RGB/HSL readout.
  3. Click any pixel to pin it to the picked list.
  4. Use the copy button on any pinned color.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I pick a color?

Move the mouse over the image for a live readout; click to pin the color to the picked list. Each pinned color has a copy button.

Can I copy the picked colors?

Yes — each pinned color shows a copy button that copies the HEX value to your clipboard.

Is the image downscaled?

Images are drawn at most 800px on the longest side for performance; the sampled pixel still matches the displayed pixel.
